BiblicalUsage: To draw is to pull the sword out. The keeper of the prison at Philippi draws out his sword to kill himself, supposing the prisoners had fled, and one who stood by Jesus in the garden drew a sword and smote a servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the drawn sword shows the two ways men answer a crisis: the jailer turned it on himself, and the disciple turned it on another, and neither was the way of Christ.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
